question: What kind of divine forms are to be imagined here, given the restriction placed on their parts?
premises: Divine forms are the object to be imagined.
Those forms are described as having unmanifest parts.
A gerundive enjoins their being imagined under that description.
inference: Divine forms that have unmanifest parts are to be imagined.
uncertainties: The number and identity of the forms are not specified by these tokens alone.
plain_english: Divine forms with unmanifest parts are to be imagined.
